description.value: Installed just behind your aural cavity, this tiny processing unit intercepts and interprets verbal audio using its limited onboard database, translating it on the fly into a language you can understand. You can understand, but not speak, one additional language, chosen when you install this augmentation. You can change the stored language during your daily preparations, but it must be to a language you can secure translation data for, typically one spoken by your companions or near the current settlement.
